question: As an active member I want a kayak delivered to my contiguous-US address and two tent pole sections replaced through paid repair. The repair quote separately says shipping is 12 dollars. Does membership make kayak delivery or the repair free? What are the two totals?

searches.query: As an active member I want a kayak delivered to my contiguous-US address and two tent pole sections replaced through paid repair. The repair quote separately says shipping is 12 dollars. Does membership make kayak delivery or the repair free? What are the two totals?

chunks.text: Published repair charges  The repair workshop offers a tent pole-section replacement for USD 18 per section and a sleeping-bag zipper-slider replacement for USD 25. These prices cover the named repair work only. Any transport charge is stated in the individual quotation. Other repairs, including a torn tent floor, require a quote after assessment. There is no published flat price for a tent-floor replacement.  A manufacturing fault approved under warranty is handled under the product's warranty terms rather than automatically charged as a paid repair. An accidental tear or wear outside the warranty can still be assessed for paid repair. The workshop tells the customer the scope and price before work begins. The customer must approve the quotation; sending an item for assessment is not approval for an unspecified charge.  Active members receive priority queue handling but pay the same published repair prices. Priority is not a completion guarantee.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

Oversize delivery for kayaks and cargo boxes  Kayaks and rigid roof cargo boxes are oversize products. Delivery to an eligible address in the contiguous United States costs USD 35 per order containing oversize items. Neither the ordinary free-shipping threshold nor the membership threshold waives this fee. Adding a small accessory to the order does not turn the oversize shipment into an ordinary parcel.  Oversize deliveries use a scheduled ground carrier. Express parcel service is not available for these products. The carrier contacts the customer to arrange an appointment after the shipment is ready. The documentation does not provide a fixed appointment date for any particular order. Support must check the live shipment record before discussing an actual delivery appointment.  At delivery, inspect the outer packaging before signing and photograph visible transport damage. If damage is discovered afterward, use the delivery-damage reporting policy. Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock.

An approved manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid ground label. For a paid repair, shipping is included only if the individual quotation says so. Warranty decisions apply to the specific damage inspected. A previous approved claim does not guarantee that a different problem will also be covered.

Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service. A customer cannot pay a surcharge to remove a product restriction. The membership benefit covers qualifying standard delivery only. It does not discount the USD 18 express price or change the cutoff time.

Standard delivery prices  For ordinary parcels to the contiguous United States, standard ground delivery costs USD 6 when the qualifying merchandise subtotal is below USD 75. At USD 75 or more, standard delivery is free. The qualifying subtotal is calculated after discounts and before sales tax. Gift cards do not count toward it. A basket that was above the threshold before a discount may fall below it afterward.  An active store membership reduces the free standard-delivery threshold to USD 40. The membership must be active when the order is placed. Becoming a member later does not retroactively refund an earlier delivery charge. Membership is linked to the purchasing customer, not automatically to everyone at the same address.  Oversize products have a separate delivery charge and do not receive free delivery under either threshold. The oversize-delivery article explains the fee. Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery.

International deliveries and returns  The store ships eligible ordinary products to Canada and the United Kingdom. International standard shipping costs USD 22 per order. Domestic membership and ordinary free-delivery thresholds do not apply to international shipping. Local import taxes and customs charges are paid by the recipient and are separate from the amount charged by the store.  Lithium-battery products, kayaks, and rigid roof cargo boxes are excluded from international delivery. An item being small enough to fit in a parcel does not remove a lithium-battery restriction. An international customer must not select a domestic destination as a placeholder and expect support to reroute a restricted product across the border.  Eligible international change-of-mind returns use the normal unused-condition and return-window rules. The customer arranges and pays the return transport. The store does not issue the USD 7 domestic return label for an international parcel. Import taxes are not refunded by the store.

Who pays for a return label  For ordinary domestic change-of-mind returns, the store offers a ground label for USD 7 per parcel. If the customer uses it, USD 7 is deducted from the refund or store credit. A customer may instead arrange and pay for their own suitable carrier. A store label covers one parcel; two parcels require two labels. Membership does not waive this fee.  An approved wrong-item shipment or manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid label without the USD 7 deduction. The support team must approve that reason first. A customer selecting a defect reason in the portal is not sufficient proof that the claim has been approved. The hiking boot fit trial is a fit return, so the normal USD 7 label fee applies unless the customer supplies their own shipping.  Use suitable packaging and keep the carrier acceptance receipt. Items containing an undamaged lithium battery must use the eligible ground service.

Priority is not a completion guarantee. Current workshop capacity, parts availability, and a particular item's repair status are maintained in the live repair system, not in this price list. A request for a completion date requires checking that record. Do not infer it from a price or from membership alone.

answer.answer: Membership does not make kayak delivery or the repair free. Kayaks are oversize products, and the oversize-delivery fee is not waived by membership or the free-shipping threshold. For repairs, active members pay the same published prices and membership does not waive repair prices. The two totals are: Kayak delivery: USD 35. Tent pole repair: USD 48 (USD 18 per section × 2 sections = USD 36 for labor, plus USD 12 shipping stated in the quote).
